scripts.build: npm run build -w @htmlppt/runtime && npm run build -w @htmlppt/core && npm run build -w @htmlppt/host && npm run build -w @htmlppt/cli && npm run build -w @htmlppt/editor
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @htmlppt/core && npm run test -w @htmlppt/editor
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test -w @htmlppt/host && npm run test -w @htmlppt/cli

scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run test:e2e
